[name="明椒"]（紧张地摇头）
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="赫德雷")]恐怕我们已经错过了些很重要的事——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[multiline(name="赫德雷",end=true)]嘶……他是真想杀了我。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_clothmovement",volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_4087_ines_1#1$1",posfrom="-50,0",posto="-20,0",duration=0.8)]
[charslot(slot="l",afrom=0,ato=1,duration=0.3)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_4087_ines_1#1$1",posfrom="-20,0",posto="-20,0",focus="l")]
[name="伊内丝"]给自己点恢复的时间。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]还死不了。当务之急是联系上博士和W。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]如果她在通讯里提到的事情都属实……那现在，她很需要我们。
[name="赫德雷"]看来这场仗的走向，已经完全超出我的预料了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]摄政王，特蕾西娅殿下，你们到底做了什么……
